method: Pinned taste@1 DOM collection and scoring executed through the provided browser tool after the CLI could not launch a browser. Motion check confirms absence of motion; reduced motion was not emulated.

checks.name: render
checks.output: renders, no script errors or missing local files

checks.name: layout
checks.output:
no horizontal scroll at 320, 390 or 1440
no text box overlaps another
no floating control covers text
no text cut off by overflow: hidden

checks.name: targets
checks.output:
all 13 controls at least 24px or spaced at 390
0 under the 44px comfortable size

checks.name: tracking
checks.output: letter-spacing natural in content (display type may run tight)

checks.name: type-sizes
checks.output:
390: 5 sizes in use, 6 with one-offs (14px×25, 16px×46, 18px×28, 22px×14, 32px×9, 56px×1)
1440: 5 sizes in use, 6 with one-offs (14px×25, 16px×46, 18px×28, 22px×14, 32px×9, 96px×1)
bar: 6 sizes used more than once, 8 counting one-offs, per width

checks.name: glyphs
checks.output: no em dashes or emoji in text

checks.name: copy-budget
checks.output:
prose on the first screen: 20 words at 390 (bar 60), 20 at 1440 (bar 90)
all words on the first screen: 85 at 390, 131 at 1440
whole page: 897 words, 251 of them prose

checks.name: chrome
checks.output:
border and shadow together: 0
cards inside cards: 0
gradient text: 0

checks.name: motion
checks.output: No authored transitions or animations. Zero running animations observed. Reduced motion emulation was not performed in this browser tool.

checks.name: share
checks.output: title "Feed Claus. A one week FLOP testnet trial.", favicon, og:title, og:image, description

textEnlargement.method: Root font size 200%, separate from native browser zoom

limitations: Original taste CLI could not launch its expected browser executable.
Reduced motion preference was not emulated. No animation or transition is authored.
No WebKit, physical device, native browser zoom, forced colors, print or screen reader session.
External research URLs were not fetched.
